'''''The Victory of Kidron''''' is a three-masted [[Seanchan]] greatship.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Victory of Kidron, the}}

==Appearance and opperation==
The ''Kidron'' has ribbed sails, as is common on Seanchan vessels, and three tall masts. The ship requires six helmsmen to control the tiller.

==Activities==
The ''Kidron'' is the ship that brought [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]] to the [[Westlands]]. The ship is captained by [[Tehan]]. In addition to the Daughter of the Nine Moons, the ship carried Tuon's personal entourage, several people of the [[Blood]], six ''[[sul'dam]]'' and ''[[damane]]'' pairs, two dozen [[Ogier]] [[Gardener]]s, over five hundred of the [[Deathwatch Guard]], as well as the crew.{{ref/book|9|14}}
